lines: Different from many online LaTeX or Typst editors, Texpile requires you to open a folder.
Click Open Folder… on the start screen. If you have no existing projects, create an empty
folder in your system's file explorer (Finder) first and then open it.
Texpile reopens your folders at the next launch, each on its last file.
In an empty folder, Start a New Document offers LaTeX and Typst templates. Click one and
Texpile copies its files into the folder.
Browse Typst Templates… adds community templates from Typst Universe. File › Save as
Template… turns a folder of your own into a template under Your Templates.
For Markdown, choose File › New › Markdown File. Markdown has no compile step.
Press Ctrl Alt Enter, or Compile at the top of the PDF (Show PDF in the title bar opens it). The
PDF and build files go into an output folder next to the main file.
If Texpile finds no TeX on your computer, Set Up LaTeX opens and offers Install TeX Live. For
Typst, the bar above the file has Set Up Typst, which installs tinymist. See Installation.
With several documents and no main file set, Texpile asks once which one to compile. To
change it, right-click a file and choose Set as Main File.
